title: shadow_to_opacity rendering issues
body: ### Tested versions Haven't check far enough back yet but we're pretty sure this worked correctly in Godot 4.3 and earlier. Verified broken on Godot 4.5 and Godot 4.6 dev2, can't test master because master currently crashes. ### System information Windows 11 - Godot 4.6 dev2 - Quest 3 ### Issue description `shadow_to_opacity` shaders are no longer behaving correctly. This is verified when stereo rendering though it could be related to TBDR/mobile GPUs and working correctly on desktop GPUs. Expected behaviour in our use case when using `shadow_to_opacity` together with `unshaded` is that geometry is written to color, filling the color with ALPHA 0.0 and that the depth buffer is filled so objects behind are properly occluded by the transparent area. This allows us to "hole punch" and make passthrough visible. The test project we're referring to here draws a box this way so a user can see their keyboard: ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/39957416-2a96-4981-9c1a-4471c3863f3e) On compatibility there seems to be a drawing order, it's almost like the depth buffer isn't written to. Some geometry is occluded correctly, some isn't. It can be worked around by setting the render priority of the hole punch material to -99, and you can force the issue by setting it to 99. On mobile things really go weird, the project halts to a grind, and eventually just quits, so we have a more serious issue on our hands on mobile. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Create some geometry in a scene 2. Make sure one of the objects has our hole punch shader: ```glsl shader_type spatial; render_mode blend_mix, depth_draw_opaque, shadow_to_opacity, unshaded; void fragment() { ALBEDO = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0); } ``` 3. Make sure we have a camera and the usual setup 4. If I'm correct its TBDR hardware, this could be reproducible on any mobile device, else make sure the project is setup for XR and export to a Quest ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) This demo is setup for this: https://github.com/BastiaanOlij/godot-demo-projects/tree/openxr-passthrough-demo/xr/openxr-passthrough-demo Just change the render priority on the holepunch material to 99 to reproduce:
